state:
**Goal `ci-green` — CI is green on `main` — is met, and so is its proofs floor.** Commit
`a5e98c23a` rewrote `docs/reference/lang/30-expressions.md`, which staled the perf figure of
every `lang:expressions` feature whose anchor is that chapter, and grew two `about.md` files past
200 words. This session measured the fourteen again into `docs/perf/members.ndjson` on the release
binary and cut `precedence-and-associativity/about.md` and `nvs-lsp/about.md` back under the bound,
so `bun nv proofs --gate` owes nothing over the whole roster.
